title: Patient Financial Account Administration Settings by Class
content:
Five administrative settings of the Patient Financial Account are set per financial class: the fee for an itemized statement of services, the business days within which a requested itemized statement is delivered, the default statement delivery channel for a new account (paperless or mail), whether the account must carry a zero balance before a closure request can take effect, and whether an agency placement is recalled when a late insurance payment reduces the placed balance.

| Financial class (tier) | Itemized statement fee (USD) | Itemized statement delivery (business days) | Default statement channel | Zero balance required for closure | Recall on late insurance payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 0.00 | 5 | mail | yes | yes |
| Self-Pay Account | 0.00 | 5 | paperless | yes | yes |
| Medicare Part B Account | 0.00 | 5 | mail | yes | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 0.00 | 5 | mail | yes | yes |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 0.00 | 5 | paperless | yes | yes |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 0.00 | 5 | paperless | yes | yes |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 0.00 | 5 | paperless | yes | yes |

**Q. Which classes start on mail?** The Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage accounts; the Self-Pay Account and the three commercial classes start paperless.

**Q. Does any class charge for an itemized statement?** No. The fee is 0.00 on every class, and delivery is within 5 business days on every class.

**Q. Do closure and recall settings vary?** No. Every class requires a zero balance for closure and recalls an agency placement when a late insurance payment reduces the placed balance.
